name: Banh xeo with nem lui
summary: A crisp rice pancake served with nem lụi, grilled pork skewers, and fresh herbs. Ninh Bình orders it after a day of sightseeing.
origin: Ninh Bình, as the plate with nem lụi. This is not the southern crepe.
howToEat: Eat it with rau sống and nem lụi, after a day of visiting the sights.
seoTitle: Banh xeo with nem lui — Ninh Binh
seoDescription: The Ninh Bình pancake plate: crisp bánh xèo with nem lụi and herbs, after a day of sightseeing.
